snippet.title: SILLY POLLY BEAST ► Nintendo Switch 2 Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
ALREADY OUT ON PC + PS5 + XBOX! 
Store page on the Nintendo eShop coming soon!

_Silly Polly. Stupid Polly. You've come back to ruin everything again, haven't you?_

Embrace your inner demon or be consumed by it. An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. SILLY POLLY BEAST is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?
